meta.dataset: pp_sales_pa_b - Property transfers (deeds/sales) for Punctual Pros / BSP portfolio service-area counties in PA: Berks, Lebanon, Franklin, Adams, Perry, Chester, Montgomery
method: All data pulled live from public county ArcGIS REST query endpoints with curl/python (browser UA), POST /query, outSR=4326, f=json, paginated with resultOffset + resultRecordCount (1000-2000) ordered by OID until exceededTransferLimit=false.

Montgomery: GIS_BOA_LAND FeatureServer/0 (table) where SALE_DATE_1 >= DATE '2025-09-01'; centroids from Parcels/Montgomery_County_Parcels FeatureServer/10 (TAXPIN IN (...) batches of 250, returnCentroid=true); MUNI_CODE->municipality name derived by point-in-polygon against Voters/Montgomery_County_Voting_Districts (majority vote per code).

Chester: Parcels_owners FeatureServer/0 where DEED_REC_DATE >= DATE '2025-09-01', returnCentroid=true; MUNI code -> name from Chester_County_Municipalities; de-duplicated multi-polygon parcels on (UPI, date).

Berks: Berks_Assessment_CAMA_Master_File FeatureServer/14 where SALEDT between 2025-09-01 and 2026-09-24 (future-dated junk excluded); joined on PARID=PROPID to Berks_County_Parcels_V2 FeatureServer/2 (centroid, MUNICIPALNAME, CLASS) and CAMA_Residential_File FeatureServer/15 (YRBLT, SFLA, BEDROOMS; card 1).

Lebanon: LandRecords/TaxParcels MapServer/0 (utility.arcgis.com proxy used by the county Parcel Viewer web map) where SALE_DATE >= DATE '2025-09-01'; polygon returned and centroid computed locally (area-weighted, largest ring).

Franklin: TaxRecords/FC_TaxRecords MapServer/0 where SALE_DATE >= DATE '2024-08-01' (source lag, see caveats); centroid computed locally; municipality by point-in-polygon on FranklinGIS/ReferenceLayers MapServer/1; seller = PREVIOUS_OWNER_1.

Adams: AGOL/Parcel_Owners MapServer/0 where SALE_DATE LIKE '%/2026' OR SALE_DATE LIKE '09/%/2025' OR SALE_DATE LIKE '1_/%/2025' (string MM/DD/YYYY), parsed and filtered locally to >= 2025-09-01; centroid computed locally.

Perry: Perry_County_Web_Map_WFL1 FeatureServer/2 where SLH_SALE_D >= DATE '2025-09-01', returnCentroid=true; use code/year built/living area joined on PIN from Perry_Field_Updated_gdb FeatureServer/3 (2023 reassessment field data).

Discovery via ArcGIS Online sharing/rest/search and county web-app config.json/web-map JSON; no records invented; exact-duplicate rows from multi-part parcels dropped (156 rows: Perry 88, Adams 64, Franklin 4).

coverage.source: Montgomery County PA Board of Assessment - GIS_BOA_LAND table (gis.montcopa.org)
coverage.fields_available: SALE_DATE_1/CONSIDERATION; OWN1/OWN2 (current owner=buyer); LOCATION1, LOC_ZIP; CLASS/LAND_USE; SFLA, YEAR_BUILT, BEDROOMS; parcel centroid via Montgomery_County_Parcels TAXPIN join; no seller

coverage.source: Chester County PA - Parcels_owners layer (ChesterCountyGIS, ArcGIS Online)
coverage.fields_available: DEED_REC_DATE (deed recording date)/LAST_SALE_PRICE; OWN1/OWN2 (buyer); LOC_ADDRESS; CLASS/LUC; zip only when owner mailing addr = situs; no seller/year_built/sqft/beds

coverage.source: Berks County PA Assessment - CAMA Master/Residential + Parcels V2 (BerksCountyGIS, ArcGIS Online)
coverage.fields_available: SALEDT/PRICE/OWN1 (buyer) from CAMA Master; YRBLT/SFLA/BEDROOMS from CAMA Residential; centroid+MUNICIPALNAME+CLASS from Berks_County_Parcels_V2; no seller
SALE_DATE/SALE_PRICE; OWNER/SECOND_LIS (buyer); SITUS_ADDR/SITUS_ZIP; MUNICIPAL1; PROPERTY_T/LU_CODE; YEAR_BUILT; LIVING_ARE; centroid computed from polygon; no seller/beds

coverage.source: Franklin County PA - FC_TaxRecords CAMA extract (fcgis.franklincountypa.gov)
coverage.fields_available: SALE_DATE/SLH_PRICE; FULL_OWNER (buyer); PREVIOUS_OWNER_1 (seller); FULL_SITUS_ADDR/ZIP; LAND_USE_CODE; YEAR_BUILT; CNS_AREA_LIVING; bedrooms mostly 0/blank; muni via point-in-polygon on FC_MunicipalBdy; centroid computed from polygon
SALE_DATE (MM/DD/YYYY string)/SALE_PRICE; SHORT_NAME (buyer); COMBINED_SITUS; DISTRICT_NAME; PROPERTY_TYPE; centroid computed from polygon; no seller/zip/year_built/sqft/beds

coverage.source: Perry County PA - Perry_County_Web_Map_WFL1 Parcels (perrycountypa ArcGIS Online)
coverage.fields_available: SLH_SALE_D/SLH_PRICE; SLH_DEEDED (buyer/grantee); REM_PRCL_L (situs); REM_USRFLD (muni); use/year_built/sqft from 2023 Perry_Field_Updated_gdb parcels join on PIN (may be stale); no seller/zip/beds

field_notes.source: short label; full source name in meta.coverage[].source
field_notes.use_code_raw: CL=county class, LU=land-use code, PT=property type, LUC=Chester/Berks land use code

caveats: Records are the LAST recorded sale per parcel as carried in each county's assessment/parcel layer, not a full deed-transfer ledger: a parcel sold twice in the window appears once (latest sale), and buyer = current owner of record.

Seller (grantor) is only available for Franklin (PREVIOUS_OWNER_1). builder_flag is therefore null wherever seller is unknown (all counties except Franklin); for Franklin it is a regex on seller name (builder/developer/homes/construction/communities, national builder names).

arms_length: set false when price <= $1,000 (nominal-consideration transfers: family, estate, corrective deeds); otherwise null because no county layer exposes a sale-validity code. Treat priced transfers as unverified.

Franklin County's public FC_TaxRecords CAMA extract lags ~13 months: sale dates effectively end late Jul 2025 (only 6 records after 2025-09-01, last 2025-12-17). Franklin window is therefore 2024-08-01 to 2025-12-17 (latest available ~12 months). Beds field is mostly 0 in source (treated as null).

Perry County layer last edited 2026-07-13; latest sale 2026-07-02 (~2.5 month lag). Perry use_type/year_built/sqft come from the 2023 field-data layer and may be stale or missing (115 records use_type null).
Adams County latest sale date 2026-07-15 (layer SQL_UPDATE_DATE 09/08/2026) - ~2 month recording lag; no zip, year built, sqft or beds in public layer.

Chester uses DEED_REC_DATE (deed recording date, typically days-weeks after settlement). Chester has no public year-built/sqft/beds in this layer; zip only populated when owner mailing address matches the situs address (owner-occupied).

Berks zip populated only when CAMA owner mailing address matches situs; Berks muni names lack the Township/Borough suffix; 176 Berks CAMA sales (mostly leased mobile-home 'T' parcels) have no parcel geometry (geo_precision none/zip).
Montgomery: 928 rows with no matching TAXPIN polygon fall back to geo_precision 'zip' (LOC_ZIP) with null lat/lon.
Lat/lon are parcel centroids (computed or server-returned), rounded to 5 decimals - not rooftop address geocodes.

use_type mapping: county CLASS / PA land-use codes -> residential|commercial|industrial|mixed|land|other; vacant (e.g., Chester V-xx, LU 100/113) -> land; farms with buildings (LU 112) -> other; raw codes retained in use_code_raw.
Median prices by county are for price > $1,000 only; includes non-residential.
File is ~26.6 MB (44,404 records, no county exceeded 40k so no sampling applied); per-item source is a short label to save space.

QA 2026-09-24: Validated pp_sales_pa_b.json; removed 12,463 items (28.1%) with non-null price < $1000 (nominal $0-$500 consideration transfers, mostly family/estate transfers) that failed the price>=1000-or-null rule. No exact-duplicate ids found (0 dupes among 44,404). All lat/lon within plausible PA bounds. All sale_date values valid ISO dates within 2015-01-01..2026-09-24. meta.coverage counts corrected to reflect per-county counts of the 31,941 remaining valid items (previously reflected raw pre-filter counts).
